data.message: I individually commit to 18 tons, regardless of others: an opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each switch from 10 adds $8,000 now if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k; stock left=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). This risks lower future income, not guaranteed long-run gains. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. Each of you: state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others. Will you opt for 18?
